analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($87,275) vs SMA5 ($97,152)/SMA20 ($106,518)/SMA50 ($106,273): below short/mid-term trends, indicating weakness.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($115,357)/SMA200 ($99,142): confirming long-term downtrend.
· 52-week position (35.5%) + current price level in historical low range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (48.8 → 23.8): entering oversold territory, strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (hist -2.4173 → -2420.0486): continued worsening, bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (lower band $93,200): approaching lower band, potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($82,500): excessive decline from 20-day low.
· Swing resistance ($89,550): limited upside from 5-day high.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower High): confirming continued downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.50x): increased volume amidst decline, signaling strengthening selling pressure.
· Current phase diagnosis (downtrend): high probability of further decline, maintaining wait-and-see approach.
